items.question: What position does the interval of the knees occupy among measures beginning from the thigh?
premises: Measures are reckoned in sequence beginning from the thigh.
The knees possess a definable interval or space.
This knee interval corresponds to the middle of those thigh-based measures.
items.inference: Therefore, in sequential order, the interval of the knees is identified as the middle of the measures beginning from the thigh.
uncertainties: The exact anatomical boundaries of the knee interval are not specified within this verse alone.
items.plain_english: In due sequence, the interval of the knees is the middle of the measures beginning from the thigh.
